verdict.rationale: This is an Agent Skill package, a tool consumed by agents rather than an agent itself, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows distribution only as an Agent Skills folder (SKILL.md), a Claude plugin marketplace install, or a zip upload. Nothing documents an MCP server or endpoint. The skill format is an adjacent integration path, not an MCP server, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
